lines.en: Who do you think would win in a fight?
I'd have to give the edge to Phoebe.
Okay? Plus, she's got this crazy temper.
She's not standing right behind me, is she?
All right, well, do you think I could take Rachel?
What? Come on, I am tough.
Put, you know, put me right here as hard as you can.
What are you taking this so seriously for?
Okay, well, what would you say if I told you that,
you know, I thought Ross or Chandler could beat you up?
Hey, Ursula's fiancé is really sweet.
He does all this volunteer work.
You know, normally, you know, I don't like really sweaty guys,
but this one, I could just mop them up.
You're getting a crush on your sister's fiancé.
